summary: Owned Bahia-maintained OpenClaw SoulFactory sidecar adapter for the shared Nostr runtime control contract.
observed_context: docs/plans/soulfactory-nostr-agent-lifecycle-2026-05-14.md defines runtime capability/control/result kinds 30317/38384/38386 and forbids REST lifecycle control or polling completion semantics.
docs/soulfactory-runtime-control.md defines required tags, request/result envelopes, trust, idempotency, and method params.
The product decision for bahia-8ycd.4 requires an owned sidecar rather than direct upstream OpenClaw modifications.
intended_behavior: The sidecar publishes compatible OpenClaw runtime capabilities.
The sidecar validates signed addressed SoulFactory control requests before invoking local OpenClaw control seams.
The sidecar publishes correlated runtime results and avoids REST/polling completion semantics.
